mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.project_id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.assignee_id, u.real_name AS assignee_name, t.creator_id, t.estimated_hours, t.actual_hours, t.due_date, t.sort_order, t.create_time FROM t_task t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.assignee_id = u.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.status, t.sort_order ASC, t.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_task SET actual_hours = actual_hours + #{hours} WHERE id = #{taskId}
